exposure: antibiotic prophylaxis (2 g doses of cephazolin perioperatively)
postoperative antibiotics (two doses of 1 g cephazolin postoperatively and oral preparations of 500 mg of cephuroxime twice daily for 5 days after hospital discharge)
cohort: The study population consisted of 5787 women who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Increased rates of wound infections were observed in emergency cesarean deliveries, and postoperative antibiotics did not have a major impact in reducing the rate of wound infection following cesarean section.
